title: Example 148 (B11, advised contracts): full jitter proved below the cap on an agent's contracts, 1 proved against the JDK's bytecode, 2 tested on the JVM
description: New example for steps 3c/3e of llm-dlc/loops/sound-verdicts.md: the recorded example of a proof that closes only through agent-written contracts. The same Crosscut change as example 147 (Jitter#fullJitterMillis), with the nextInt contract corrected to throw IllegalArgumentException when bound <= 0. Under --engine native --gaps advised --contracts gaps.contracts the contract for Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros is proved against the bytecode of java.lang.Integer from the JDK image, the two for java.util.Random are tested on a real JVM, and the property (result in [0, capMillis), IllegalArgumentException for an invalid policy) is proved on every input. The page should show both evidence levels.
expected: verdict verified, relying on 3 contracts for gaps of the tool's own checker, 1 proved, 2 tested; result.search.gaps records the proof (class java.lang.Integer, sha256 digest) and the testing of each; the label says (1 proved, 2 tested)

resources.notes: checked inline on the patched module: about 0.2 s for the contract checks and the proof; the build and the module's tests take most of the time
